visual.name: dateSlicer
visual.description: Date and period slicer: calendar, timeline and compact bar; presets that keep rolling after publishing (YTD, MTD, rolling 12 months, fiscal); ISO weeks starting Monday, Sunday or Saturday, retail 4-4-5, holidays for 21 countries, working days, and comparison periods for your measures, including any second range your viewers pick. Part of the SmartVisuals family for Power BI.
